answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, idle agents bleed standing. A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the fable of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
